Ask about a day

Do we have to use your caterer?
No. We have four we know well and will happily recommend, but you can bring anyone with the right certificates.
What happens if it rains?
Everything works indoors. The courtyard is the bonus, not the plan — we learned that the first summer.
Can we stay the night?
Eight in the loft above the barn, and the farmhouse up the lane takes another twelve.
